Let <MATH_0001> be a ring. Suppose we consider the ring
<MATH_0002>.
The cardinality of this ring is bounded by <MATH_0003>,
but is not bounded by <MATH_0004> in general.
For example if <MATH_0005> it is not bounded by
<MATH_0006> and if <MATH_0007>
it is not bounded by <MATH_0008>.
Thus the ``And so on'' of Lemma <REF_0001> above
should be taken with a grain of salt. Of course, if it ever becomes
necessary to consider these rings in arguments pertaining to
fppf/<ACCENT_0001>tale cohomology, then we can change the function
<MATH_0009> above into the function <MATH_0010>.
